Algorithm 1 Cache Management via Belady's Algorithm
Input: Bucket read sequence S, bucket number M, cache size C
1: Bucket queue Q ← Max_Heap(C)
2: Bucket position P ← Array(M, List())
3: Bucket access count c ← Array(M, 0)
4: for i ∈ {1 · · |S|} do ▷ Store access time for each bucket
5:    P[S[i]].append(i)
6: for i ∈ {1 · · |S|} do ▷ Enumerate bucket access sequence
7:    b ← S[i], c[b] ← c[b] + 1
8:    if Cache.find(b) = true then ▷ Cache hit
9:    Q.update(b, P[b][c[b]])
10:    else ▷ Cache miss
11:    if Q.size = C then
12:    b' ← Q.pop(), Cache.evict(b')
13:    Cache.load(b), Q.push(b, P[b][c[b]])

Algorithm 2 Task Ordering with Graph Reordering
Input: Bucket graph G(V, E), sliding window size w = C / davg
Output: An ordering P for the nodes in G
1: select a node v as the start node, P[1] ← v
2: V_R ← V(G) \ {v}, i ← 2
3: while i ≤ n do ▷ Greedily insert remaining nodes to P
4:    v_max ← max_v ∈ V_R ∑_{j=max{1,i-w}}^{i-1} |N(P[j]) ∩ N(v) |
5:    P[i] ← v_max, i ← i + 1
6:    V_R ← V_R \ {v_max}
7: return P

Algorithm 3 Probabilistic Pruning for Candidate Buckets
Input: Target recall λ, candidate bucket list L for bucket b
Output: Pruned candidate bucket list L′
1: L′ ← L, sum ← 0
2: for bi ∈ L in descending order of distance to b do
3:    sum ← sum + arccos(min{xi, 1})
4:    if sum ≥ 1 - λ then ▷ Stop when error exceeds 1 - λ
5:    break
6:    L′ ← L'\{bi}
7: return L′
